title: Post-merger knowledge withholding
accepted_explanation: Employees from the acquired firm are not collaborative.
observations: Teams compete for the same internal revenue credits.
Specialist knowledge is tied to individual utilization targets.
Employees describe sharing knowledge as helping another team meet its quota.
Knowledge sharing is higher where managers pool credit across teams.
participant_claims: Executives attribute friction to incompatible cultures.
researcher_interpretations: Competitive incentives may be reinforcing an emergent norm of withholding.
assumptions: Pre-merger cultural differences are the primary cause.
missing_evidence: Sharing behavior before and after incentive changes.
